title: Public Sanitary Fixture Display Alcove
description: One static public-service sanitary-fixture display alcove, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete original assets are reused at unit scale: the oval-pan rear-cistern toilet at left, an open wall-changing station at right, and a raised wall-grab rail between them. Every original raw GLB triangle and opaque solid PBR is embedded in the self-contained generator; only one declared translation per complete assembly and material-name prefixes for collision protection are added. A new scene-only closed floor and continuous L cutaway wall present the fixtures with visible open front floor. Thirty-one editable meshes, twelve materials. No baby/person, water/plumbing, electrical or mechanical operation. This is a static fixture exhibit, not a complete usable restroom, accessibility or human-clearance test, care product recommendation, installation plan, load or safety certification.
